name: network-input-fallback
title: Network input fallback policy
description: Implement an allocation-free deterministic network-input fallback evaluator and explicit delay/jitter/loss/reorder/disconnect/restart tests without target hardware.
scope: backend-neutral middleware input fallback evaluation and Zenoh network-fault integration tests
creator: mj
notes: Software-only D3 child complete. The backend-neutral decision matrix is allocation-free; the Zenoh adapter rejects foreign and prior-boot caches before fallback. The scripted fault matrix covers delay, jitter, loss, duplicate, reorder, expiry, quality, unexpected source, disconnect, reconnect, replacement boot and retired boot with exact expiries/counters. Final tools/ci.sh passed. Network/target latency qualification and Orange Pi evidence remain out of scope.
